answer: The jetty chain is verified at intake and nadir publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 11 epochs old, anchored at a ember checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 11 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That bill is paid per identity, so 109 aliases cost 45 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
